project_type_benchmarks_scope_unique.name: project_type_benchmarks_scope_unique
project_type_benchmarks_scope_unique.where: "project_type_benchmarks"."archived_at" is null and "project_type_benchmarks"."scope_kind" is not null

projects_dates_in_order.name: projects_dates_in_order
projects_dates_in_order.value: "projects"."start_date" is null or "projects"."target_end_date" is null or "projects"."target_end_date" >= "projects"."start_date"

timesheet_rows_type_links.name: timesheet_rows_type_links
timesheet_rows_type_links.value:
case "timesheet_rows"."row_type"
        when 'project' then "timesheet_rows"."overhead_category_id" is null
        when 'overhead' then "timesheet_rows"."project_id" is null and "timesheet_rows"."project_phase_id" is null
        when 'leave' then "timesheet_rows"."project_id" is null and "timesheet_rows"."project_phase_id" is null
        else "timesheet_rows"."project_id" is null and "timesheet_rows"."project_phase_id" is null and "timesheet_rows"."overhead_category_id" is null and "timesheet_rows"."activity_id" is null
      end
